## Context

- Today [`App`](https://github.com/QueryaHub/OxyRoute/blob/main/oxyroute/app.py) is a **flat** registry: every route is registered on one object. Large APIs need **namespaced** paths (`/api/v1/...`, `/admin/...`) without repeating prefixes on every decorator.
- See [Feature gaps](https://github.com/QueryaHub/OxyRoute/blob/main/docs/feature.md#3-маршрутизация-и-композиция).

## Direction

- Add something like `APIRouter` / `include_router(router, prefix=..., **defaults)` in Python, merging route tables and OpenAPI paths into the parent `App` before `freeze()`.
- Alternatively: a **prefix** argument on the existing `get/post/...` decorators only (weaker, but less API surface).
- OpenAPI: merged `paths` must remain valid; duplicate path+method should error at register time.

## Acceptance criteria

- At least one example under `examples/` with two routers and a shared prefix.
- Pytest: routes under prefix resolve; OpenAPI lists prefixed paths.
- Document in `docs/routing.md`.

## Research

- FastAPI `APIRouter`; Starlette `Router` / mounts.
